newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 3-mth coupon T-bill issue March 12.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 3-mth coupon T-bill issue March 12.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer a three-month floater coupon T-bill issue with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance on Wednesday, the central bank said.
The coupon equals the central bank main interest rate, now set at 18 percent monthly or 216 percent annually.
Apart from that issue the ministry on Wednesday offers its regular one- and four-week discount T-bill issues to drain liquidity.
The ministry has to pay some 45.5 billion levs principal and interest on five issues on Wednesday, a finance ministry official said.
